  1. GitHub Copilot App v1.3.0

    Latest GitHub Copilot App

    Stable

    Released
    12 Nov 2026
    Changes
    69

    The app can now offer a matching connector when an MCP server such as Slack needs you to sign in again, then resume your task. Local sessions ask for approval before the agent creates a GitHub issue. Saving a file now keeps its original permissions.

    Key changes

    • When an MCP server such as Slack needs you to sign in again, the conversation now offers the matching connector and can connect it in place and resume your task.
    • Reaction tooltips on issue and pull request comments and descriptions now show who reacted.
    • Diffs now show a neutral gap indicator between separated excerpts of a file, making omitted unchanged lines easier to spot.
    • The agent now asks for your approval, showing the repository, title and body, before creating a GitHub issue in local sessions.
    $ gh release view v1.3.0 --repo github/app
    All 69 changes

    Highlights 5

    • When an MCP server such as Slack needs you to sign in again, the conversation now offers the matching connector and can connect it in place and resume your task.
    • Reaction tooltips on issue and pull request comments and descriptions now show who reacted.
    • Diffs now show a neutral gap indicator between separated excerpts of a file, making omitted unchanged lines easier to spot.
    • The agent now asks for your approval, showing the repository, title and body, before creating a GitHub issue in local sessions.
    • Saving an existing file from the editor now keeps its original permissions, so executable scripts stay executable.

    Added 3

    • Diffs now show a neutral gap indicator between separated excerpts of a file, making omitted unchanged lines easier to spot.
    • Reaction tooltips on issue and pull request comments and descriptions now show who reacted.
    • When an MCP server such as Slack needs you to sign in again, the conversation now offers the matching connector, which stays signed in, and can connect it in place and resume your task.

    Changed 2

    • Questions from a coordinated child session now stay in that child session instead of being repeated to the parent agent or creating a second prompt when relayed.
    • The automation run title menu now matches the session title menu, with Schedule and Usage submenus, an Enabled switch, and shorter Edit, Copy link and Delete actions

    Fixed 59

    • A finished plan review now keeps its outcome, such as the plan changes you requested or that you approved the plan, under the "Plan created" card in the chat.
    • Adding a repository from Quick Open by pasting its URL now selects it in the new chat's repository picker once the clone finishes.
    • Agents in Azure DevOps sessions can now comment on other pull requests and start new comment threads instead of refusing
    • An empty New file or rename box in the Files panel now closes when you click away, even after pressing Enter on it more than once. Pressing Enter on a blank name now asks you to enter a file or folder name.
    • Blank lines in composer drafts are now preserved when you navigate away and return to a session
    • Changing the model twice while a reply is streaming no longer shows the "Model changed" rows in reverse order
    • Closing the date range picker after choosing "is between" on a date filter no longer leaves the filter reading "Select a range" while the previous date is still applied
    • Conversation timeline previews are easier to reach: moving diagonally from a tick to its preview card no longer dismisses it or selects a neighboring tick.
    • Creating a new file in the Files panel with the name of an existing file no longer empties that file; it now shows an error instead
    • Dashboard widgets no longer reload their content when you move them to a different position or column
    • Deleted sessions no longer reappear in the sidebar after a delayed refresh.
    • Dismissing the line range tip above a file with the keyboard now moves focus into the file, with a visible focus ring, instead of dropping it.
    • Fixed an Advanced filter in My Work showing a condition count on its pill while its conditions were not applied to the list.
    • Fixed the New automation dialog wrongly reporting a local project as unavailable and blocking Start session after switching from Create manually to Create with agent
    • Fixed uploaded images and saved folder access being blocked in sessions where your organization's policy requires the sandbox.
    • Forking a chat from a response now updates the URL to the forked chat, so Back, Forward, and the restored route on next launch point to the fork instead of the original chat
    • In My work, the Created, Updated, Merged and Comments filters no longer silently drop a second bound when you edit them in Simple mode, and an inclusive date window now shows as one "is between" filter.
    • In narrow windows or at high zoom, an open chat or Project panel now fills the whole area instead of squeezing the conversation and panel side by side
    • In the My work filter bar, the Milestone, Project, Base and Head filters now show every value in the query, including excluded ones ("is not"), and removing one value no longer drops the others
    • Install plugin in a repository's Code tab now finds plugin marketplace catalogs at the repository root and in .plugin/marketplace.json
    • Keyboard focus now moves to the Automations heading when you use the breadcrumb to go back to the automations gallery, so focus is no longer lost and screen readers announce the page.
    • Keyboard shortcuts such as Ctrl+F, Ctrl+W and Ctrl+B now work on Hindi and Thai keyboard layouts.
    • MCP server badges in Customize no longer flip from Connected to "Connecting…" when you return to the page and a server is slow to reconnect.
    • New automations and Side chats no longer fail when your saved default model is no longer available; they now start on the default model instead.
    • On Windows, shutting down, restarting or signing out while the app is running no longer shows a "git.exe - Application Error" popup for each session worktree.
    • Opening or switching back to a conversation with Mermaid diagrams no longer makes the conversation jump while the diagrams render again
    • Plan and usage links in Settings > Accounts now tell screen readers that they open in a new browser tab
    • Project Overview sections now stay collapsed or expanded when you switch to another Project and back
    • Pull request and issue cards an agent publishes from a GitHub Enterprise Cloud data-residency (ghe.com) repository open in the browser instead of failing
    • Pull request checks no longer appear empty when they only partially load or fail to load, and a Retry action is now available.
    • Removed the distracting outline that could appear around the image viewer when opening an image preview
    • Renaming a project no longer moves it to the top of the sidebar
    • Renaming a repository session no longer moves it to the top of the sidebar or marks it as just updated
    • Repository pickers in the New session composer and New automation dialog now find repositories when you search by owner or owner/name.
    • Running /restart-session in a new Project no longer moves keyboard focus from the message box to the onboarding cards
    • Saving an existing file from the editor now keeps its original permissions, so executable scripts stay executable instead of being reset to owner-only access.
    • Screen readers and voice control now announce the Advanced filter condition buttons by the field, operator, and value shown on screen.
    • Screen readers now announce that "See subscriptions" and "Open Copilot settings" on the onboarding screens open in a new browser tab.
    • Screen readers now announce the "is" or "is not" operator on typed and date filters in the Pull requests, Issues and My work filter bars
    • Screen readers now announce the number of results (or the empty state) after you search in Inbox and Sessions widgets
    • Sending a prompt while a reply is running in a very long conversation does less work for every earlier turn.
    • Splitting or moving a tab in the side panel now keeps keyboard focus on the moved tab instead of leaving it in the old pane or dropping it to the page body
    • Starting a chat from Home on a remote environment such as WSL no longer fails when the selected model isn't available there; Home now lists the environment's own models and falls back to its default.
    • Switching back to a conversation with a Mermaid diagram no longer makes the conversation jump after it first appears
    • The agent now asks for your approval, showing the repository, title and body, before creating a GitHub issue in local sessions, including when tool permissions are set to Allow All or Assisted
    • The Automations page no longer reports that automations couldn't be checked for repositories that have cloud automations turned off, such as public repositories you can't manage
    • The Change theme button in Settings > General is no longer cut off in narrow windows or at high zoom levels
    • The Changes view now keeps your place in the diff when you switch to another session and back
    • The Chats group in the Sessions sidebar shows a + button on hover again, so you can start a new chat in one click.
    • The Connection Lost screen now appears above Settings and other open dialogs, keeps keyboard focus on Try again, and returns focus to where you were when the connection comes back.
    • The conversation timeline preview card now returns to the keyboard-selected prompt when the pointer leaves, instead of staying on the last prompt you hovered.
    • The elapsed time on a chat's progress row now counts from when the running turn started, so a reloaded window or a chat opened in a new window no longer restarts at 0s.
    • The file sidebar in the Files and Changes tabs no longer squeezes the file or diff view down to nothing in narrow or split panes
    • The prompt composer no longer deletes a word typed directly in front of a pasted GitHub link when it converts the link into a reference chip
    • The repository trust review dialog now always shows that instructions were cut off, even when the excerpt contains emoji.
    • The taskbar and dock badge no longer counts hidden cloud workers that the sidebar does not list, and the dock menu no longer lists them
    • The two number boxes in the Comments filter's "is between" option are now announced by screen readers as "Minimum" and "Maximum", and their placeholders are no longer cut off
    • Unpinning a session from the sidebar with the keyboard no longer loses focus when the session's group is collapsed
    • When sending a message fails in a remote or cloud session, the message and its attachments now return to the composer instead of disappearing.

  4. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.32-preview.2

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    11 Nov 2026
    Changes
    33

    Preview release that reports /interactions as the API endpoint for Gemini models using the native Gemini Interactions API and adds JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with streaming and file response modes. Fixes MCP client attribution, and a missing installed plugin now produces a plugin activation warning.

    Key changes

    • Session usage and model-call failure events can now report /interactions as the API endpoint, for Gemini models served over the native Gemini Interactions API.
    • Added JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with text, streaming, and caller-owned file response modes.
    • skill.invoked events from the skill tool, web_fetch URL permission requests, and file write prompt requests now omit absent optional fields instead of sending null, and no longer include an internal routing field, so they match the session events schema.
    • Fix MCP client attribution to use the calling application's identity and refresh it on reconnect.
    $ gh release view v1.0.32-preview.2 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 33 changes

    Changes 33

    • Session usage and model-call failure events can now report /interactions as the API endpoint, for Gemini models served over the native Gemini Interactions API.
    • Added JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with text, streaming, and caller-owned file response modes.
    • skill.invoked events from the skill tool, web_fetch URL permission requests, and file write prompt requests now omit absent optional fields instead of sending null, and no longer include an internal routing field, so they match the session events schema.
    • Fix MCP client attribution to use the calling application's identity and refresh it on reconnect.
    • Custom Windows-convention session filesystem providers support application-configured UNC paths, including additional directories and resume working directories.
    • When an enabled installed plugin's files are missing, sessions now start their other extensions and emit a plugin_activation session warning naming the plugin, instead of failing extension startup or resume.
    • Added an experimental authenticateBasic callback to the network client option, which supplies credentials when a proxy asks for Basic authentication.
    • Respect managed plugin policy when selecting or restoring a custom agent.
    • BYOK providers accept type: "google" to use Google's native Gemini Interactions API (x-goog-api-key auth).
    • fetch.send and fetch.read now report a timeoutMs or readTimeoutMs expiry during a request as FetchTransportErrorData kind "timeout" instead of "request" ("tunnel" through a Negotiate proxy).
    • A postToolUse hook that returns only textResultForLlm for a shell result now also changes that result's detailedContent, so a redaction reaches what clients display.
    • Add runtime-owned IDE endpoints through existing MCP lifecycle methods, MCP tool calls, live IDE state, and ordinary session events.
    • Preserve required serializer nulls, reuse canonical Python and Java event types, and dispose disconnected Python and Go owners before reconnect.
    • Every send blocked by a session AI-credit limit now reports the block, and in non-interactive sessions each blocked sendAndWait rejects with the session limit error instead of only the first; raising the limit with session.options.update re-arms the exhausted warning.
    • Requesting a fusionTier for a BYOK provider's model named fusion now fails with an error that names fusionTier instead of autoTier.
    • Use compatible editing tools and model-specific token and reasoning defaults for additional BYOK model names, including GPT-4o.
    • Tool completion events for a tool that sets no session log, such as grep and glob, now carry detailedContent without a postToolUse hook's additionalContext; the model text in content still includes it.
    • includedBuiltinAgents or excludedBuiltinAgents with a non-string entry is now rejected with an error instead of leaving a session whose every send fails.
    • disabledMcpServers with a non-string entry is now rejected with an error instead of silently starting every disabled MCP server.
    • session.history.truncate on a resumed session no longer lets the next prompt write the removed resume record back to the session log.
    • session.metadata.contextInfo and session.metadata.getContextAttribution return null after a session is resumed until its tools initialize, instead of a measurement that leaves out the built-in tools.
    • Go: calling Start again after the runtime process exits now retires the sessions of the lost connection, so a SendAndWait still waiting on one of them fails immediately and Stop no longer reports errors for them.
    • Update the Java SDK's Jackson dependencies to 2.23.
    • mcp.config.add and mcp.config.update no longer replace an mcp-config.json entry that is skipped as invalid; they return an error that says to remove it first.
    • A tool call no longer hangs when the host removes that tool with setTools while the call waits for permission; the call fails with a tool-unavailable result and the turn finishes.
    • Sandboxed command hook and local MCP initialization errors can identify a filesystem operation reported by the process; hook errors can also identify a blocked proxy connection.
    • Fix Java in-process runtime cleanup when startup is interrupted.
    • Report a person's answers to ask_user, user-input, plan-review and elicitation prompts with the same decisionContext label permission answers use (Node.js createAttributedResult, Python create_attributed_result, Rust AttributedResult, Go OnAttributed*Request handlers, and a DecisionContext on the .NET and Java handler results); the runtime accepts it only from the session's owning connection.
    • Copilot Connectors that an SDK host supplies are no longer blocked by an organization's "Registry only" MCP registry policy; managed allow and deny lists still apply.
    • With tool search on, session.tools.getCurrentMetadata and session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown now report the deferral the next request will use after the tool set changes, instead of the last request's.
    • Sessions now accept new messages after a host event acknowledgement timeout instead of rejecting every later send until restart.
    • Rust: sessions on a busy shared connection no longer lose session events, including external tool, permission and input requests, when notification routing falls behind.
    • SDK sessions now prioritize available enterprise-managed models over saved models when choosing a default model.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.32-preview.2 Changelog Release notes →

    Labels partial responses from interrupted or failed attempts as incomplete and gives a clear message when starting copilot from a deleted directory. /compact now respects the session AI credit limit.

    Key changes

    • Label partial responses and reasoning from interrupted or failed attempts as incomplete while preserving their text
    • Starting copilot from a directory that has since been deleted now says the directory no longer exists and how to recover, instead of crashing with a Node stack trace, and -C <directory> now works from there.

  6. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.32-preview.1

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    10 Nov 2026
    Changes
    8

    Preview release that adds Gemini 4 Carbon model metadata with low, medium, and high reasoning efforts. Relative working directories now resolve under the session directory, and sandboxed commands reject explicitly denied launch directories.

    Key changes

    • session.metadata.getWorkingDirectoryContext and the session.lsp methods now resolve a relative cwd, workingDirectory or gitRoot under the session working directory instead of the runtime process's directory.
    • A local MCP server reply with a lone UTF-16 surrogate escape is now read with a replacement character instead of timing out.
    • Sandboxed commands reject explicitly denied launch directories before enforcing execution on all supported operating systems.
    • Adds Gemini 4 Carbon model metadata with low, medium, and high reasoning efforts and medium as the default.
    $ gh release view v1.0.32-preview.1 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 8 changes

    Changes 8

    • session.metadata.getWorkingDirectoryContext and the session.lsp methods now resolve a relative cwd, workingDirectory or gitRoot under the session working directory instead of the runtime process's directory.
    • A local MCP server reply with a lone UTF-16 surrogate escape is now read with a replacement character instead of timing out.
    • Sandboxed commands reject explicitly denied launch directories before enforcing execution on all supported operating systems.
    • Adds Gemini 4 Carbon model metadata with low, medium, and high reasoning efforts and medium as the default.
    • session.options.update now applies capi.enableWebSocketResponses, so a live session can switch to the HTTP Responses transport.
    • Live plugins now use consistent marketplace precedence and reject user-global toggles for repository-controlled entries.

  9. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.32-preview.0

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    10 Nov 2026
    Changes
    18

    Preview release that lets SDKs answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from agent commands through a new shell authentication handler. Ending a session now stops its non-detached background shell commands, and managed-account changes no longer stall extension restarts.

    Key changes

    • Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session.
    • Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.
    • Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Rust: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Adding a marketplace from a two-segment relative or home path such as ./name, ../name or ~/name now adds the local directory instead of cloning a GitHub repository
    $ gh release view v1.0.32-preview.0 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 18 changes

    Changes 18

    • Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session.
    • Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.
    • Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Rust: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Adding a marketplace from a two-segment relative or home path such as ./name, ../name or ~/name now adds the local directory instead of cloning a GitHub repository
    • Ending a session with disconnect, deleteSession or client stop now stops the background shell commands it started without detach, instead of leaving them running after the runtime exits.
    • Forward supplied SDK correlation IDs to Memory requests, preserving replacements on session resume.
    • .NET: Fix the manual tool-resume sample build by using the permission-decision factory with a scoped experimental-API suppression.
    • mcp.config.remove now deletes a user MCP config entry that fails validation instead of reporting that the server was not found
    • Fixed MCP servers restarting when a session shuts down while a connection is completing.
    • Entra-derived Loki account IDs remain stable across endpoint and display-name changes.
    • session.schedule.addCron now rejects cron expressions with a seconds or year field, matching its 5-field contract, and reports an unknown time zone by name instead of as an invalid cron expression.
    • A synchronous bash tool call killed by a sandbox configuration change now fails with an explicit error instead of reporting an empty success.
    • Fixed an issue where /every and /after prompts with natural-language times could lose line breaks and indentation.
    • session.shell.exec now runs a command with a relative cwd under the session working directory instead of the runtime process's directory.
    • Session AI-credit limits now show the model a dollar cost meter after each successful tool call instead of a per-call countdown, and interactive clients with a session-limits listener are offered a top-up at 90% of the limit, before tools are disabled.
    • Preserved graceful shutdown during managed SDK bootstrap.
    • Fix custom agents losing delegation-only tools when availableTools and defaultAgent.excludedTools are combined.
    • session.tools.getCurrentMetadata and session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown no longer report a disabled MCP server's tools after a model request.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.32-preview.0 Changelog Release notes →

    All 74 changes

    Added 1

    • Experimental: answer git, ssh, and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog (enable with /experimental on)

    Improved 3

    • Selecting an unavailable account in /user switch shows recovery guidance and a retry action
    • Click anywhere in expanded reasoning to collapse it without scrolling back to the header
    • Offer a session AI-credit limit top-up at 90% usage, before the agent loses access to tools

    Fixed 69

    • Show failed and cancelled compaction outcomes in the timeline, and explain memory-pressure compactions with restart and resume guidance.

    • MCP tool results that also carry a top-level key such as skills, skill, tools or messages now reach the model instead of failing the tool call
    • /every and /after keep the line breaks and indentation of a multi-line prompt when a natural-language time is parsed from it, instead of merging lines and collapsing repeated spaces.
    • "Thought for" durations update when each reasoning part ends and no longer include time spent streaming the answer
    • Show forked sessions by name in the exit summary so their resume commands are easier to identify
    • /share file and /share html reject directory paths instead of creating hidden or misplaced export files
    • Allow copilot config to read and update settings.json files containing only comments
    • Shortened paths preserve folder names containing backslashes on Linux and macOS
    • copilot -p honors trusted repositories' includeCoAuthoredBy setting for commit trailers
    • Startup auto-install now waits for managed settings before reporting missing plugin marketplaces
    • Interactive prompts appear correctly after extensions switch a session out of autopilot.
    • /move preserves edits to files marked assume-unchanged and reports submodule changes left in the original working tree
    • Changing a setting in /statusline preserves other footer settings updated by another session while the picker is open
    • Avoid unnecessary path access prompts for in-repository reads after shell commands that change directories
    • Keep permanently approved URLs approved after /new or /clear without restarting the CLI
    • JSON prompt mode emits a final result record when authentication fails or the prompt is blank
    • Reject prompt options combined with subcommands instead of silently dropping the prompt and running the subcommand

    • Use the exact directory name typed in /cd, /cwd, and /add-dir instead of a similarly named sibling directory
    • Show control characters visibly in folder trust dialogs so folder names display without hidden formatting or extra lines
    • Show when files or directories are too large to read or list instead of reporting misleading counts in collapsed tool results
    • Warn when repository settings override a saved default model for new sessions, naming the model and settings file that still apply
    • Treat empty or fully commented repository settings files as empty settings without startup warnings or parsing errors
    • Keep the command description and exit status visible in collapsed failed shell rows with multi-line output
    • Show pasted terminal text plainly in Ctrl+R search and session confirmations so escape sequences cannot recolor or hide text
    • Sandbox settings show their effective defaults and toggle default-on options off on the first press
    • Show settings-file errors without duplicate, misleading policy-update warnings when settings.json is invalid
    • Hook changes saved from /settings apply to the next prompt without restarting the CLI
    • IDE auto-connect follows your current folder after /cd, keeping editor selections and diffs in the correct IDE
    • Expanded Shell output preserves text before and after diffs and shows file names for diff-only output
    • Keep copilot lsp list output free of warnings when plugin language servers load successfully
    • Deleting the active voice model now shows that voice mode is off and how to choose another model.
    • Show the output size instead of an incorrect match count when search results are too large to list
    • MCP server and skill enable/disable commands correctly report success for names supplied through --additional-mcp-config or --plugin-dir
    • Keep dialog borders and padding aligned when a line ends with an invisible zero-width character
    • List items in plan and task summaries stay on one line when they contain literal asterisks or sentences ending in numbers
    • Show the enabled state enforced by your organization's managed settings for built-in plugins in copilot plugin list and --json output
    • Apply changes to Disable bypass permissions mode in /settings immediately, without restarting the CLI
    • /cd, /cwd, and /add-dir select the exact directory name you type when siblings differ only by case or accents
    • Hide custom agents with built-in names from /subagents so their controls cannot change built-in agent settings
    • Preserve first-line indentation in shell command output so expanded Shell rows correctly show spacing-sensitive results such as git status --short
    • Shell commands terminated by a signal report the correct exit status, such as 137 for SIGKILL or 139 for a segmentation fault
    • Show a confirmation when a model switch queued while the agent is working takes effect
    • Show the output size instead of an incorrect line count in Shell summaries when command output is too large to display
    • Footer context usage shows the same pre-request percentage as /context.
    • Plan quota and Copilot usage stay visible in the status line, /usage and the exit summary while a GitHub-hosted model is selected, even when providers.json configures a custom provider; they are hidden only while a model from that provider is selected
    • Prompt history is no longer hidden, and then erased by the next prompt, when the file that stores session mentions for past prompts is damaged or was written by a newer version

    • Hook events and other JSON settings can be saved from their editor in /settings; unset hook events now open as an empty list
    • Resuming a session by name with --resume no longer sends the session name in telemetry; only a session ID is reported
    • Exiting no longer writes dozens of errors to the process log about cleaning up a session that has already shut down
    • /sandbox no longer replaces your saved sandbox settings with defaults when settings.json has an invalid value; it shows the load error instead, and a sandbox path saved from a permission prompt is refused rather than overwriting the sandbox block
    • A prompt submitted while Compact and switch is compacting shows as queued again, instead of disappearing until the compaction finishes
    • Disabling an MCP server updates its token count in /mcp without waiting for another model response

    • copilot -p and other CLI runs that exit within a minute now apply process-log retention, so old logs are removed after 7 days and beyond the newest 50 instead of piling up one per run
    • copilot plugin marketplace add ./name, ../name and ~/name now add the local marketplace directory instead of trying to clone a GitHub repository
