  12. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.31

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Stable

    Released
    10 Nov 2026
    Changes
    235

    Adds the Windows-only sandbox option userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths for enumerate-only access. Preserves proxy 407 errors, fixes an empty sendMessages batch failing after a Claude turn, and applies reasoning effort changes made during a tool call to the next request.

    Key changes

    • Preserve proxy 407 errors for unsupported authentication challenges without waiting for unused target TLS configuration.
    • Sandbox config: add userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths (Windows only), granting enumerate-only access to the listed paths.
    • Fixed: an empty sendMessages batch after a completed Claude turn no longer fails with "This model does not support assistant message prefill".
    • Node.js: when a tool result cannot be sent to the runtime, the SDK now logs the failure and answers the tool call with the error instead of leaving it unanswered.
    $ gh release view v1.0.31 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 235 changes

    Changes 235

    • Preserve proxy 407 errors for unsupported authentication challenges without waiting for unused target TLS configuration.
    • Sandbox config: add userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths (Windows only), granting enumerate-only access to the listed paths.
    • Fixed: an empty sendMessages batch after a completed Claude turn no longer fails with "This model does not support assistant message prefill".
    • Node.js: when a tool result cannot be sent to the runtime, the SDK now logs the failure and answers the tool call with the error instead of leaving it unanswered.
    • Telemetry header helpers avoid blocking-pool admission when their executable path requires no filesystem search.
    • Reasoning effort changes made during a tool call now apply to the next model request without waiting for another user message.
    • Session opens that fail during post-construction initialization now await native-registration retirement before reporting the original error.
    • Requests to OpenAI-compatible chat-completions providers no longer include an internal message field on skill and tool messages.
    • Creating or resuming a session, or calling setTools, with two tools of the same name now fails with an error naming the tool, instead of offering the model the first definition while some SDKs ran the last handler.
    • Copilot SDK runtime now advertises MCP Apps only when a renderer is configured.
    • A customAgents entry that a built-in agent shadows now gets the session.custom_agents_updated warning without enableConfigDiscovery, and subagent.started no longer reports its description for the built-in run.
    • Java SDK replaces SpotBugs nullability annotations with JSpecify 1.0.0.
    • Avoid waiting for MCP transport handshakes during managed-policy restoration when matching cached tools are available.
    • Support managed settings assignments that enable plugins by default.
    • Python: with the TCP transport, the SDK now reads the runtime's stderr for as long as the runtime runs, so the runtime can no longer block on a full pipe, and a runtime that exits before announcing its port is reported with its exit code and stderr.
    • .NET: a SessionFs SQLite provider can return SQL NULL as DBNull.Value (what ADO.NET readers return); such cells are now sent as null instead of failing the query.
    • Fixed scheduled and queued SDK-registered slash commands not running their handlers.
    • Java and Python: a system message section transform that returns null or None now leaves the section unchanged, instead of removing it (Java) or replacing it with "None" (Python).
    • Fixed disabledSkills, session.skills.disable and session.skills.enable to match a skill name in any letter case, as invoking the skill does, instead of silently changing nothing when the case differs.
    • Blob attachments with a MIME type the runtime cannot send now reach the model as their display name and an "omitted" note instead of being dropped silently.
    • A refusal from an OpenAI model is now returned as the assistant's reply instead of failing the turn with "No response was returned".
    • Prevent initial managed-policy publication from invalidating repository hook loading during session creation.
    • Adds experimental decisions.ask and models.list decisionModels for Copilot decision models, behind the DECISIONS_API flag.
    • Session event streams no longer include the internal session.memory_changed and instruction.update_delivery events, which the SDKs do not model (.NET reported them as unknown).
    • Add experimental memory.storeMemory callback so apps can store agent memories in their own storage.
    • Fixed view continuation skipping line suffixes at page boundaries and explicitly marked partial output from oversized lines.
    • MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash sessions now include model safety guidance in the existing SDK safety section, independently of identity customization; their child agents retain the same model policy.
    • Experimental MCP skills now expose readable server-qualified names, reuse cached discovery metadata, and avoid consent failures caused by catalog-only updates.
    • Session credentials set with accounts.set (setCredentials) or gitHubAuth.login are now refused when the supplied login is not the token's user, and no longer create a second account for a case-only variant of a saved login.
    • Python, .NET, Go, Rust and Java: when a tool result fails to send, the SDK now logs the failure and answers the tool call with the error instead of leaving the turn waiting
    • session.plan.readSqlTodos and readSqlTodosWithDependencies now read a SessionFs SQLite database instead of always answering empty.
    • Rust: the session_fs example now implements every core SessionFsProvider method and creates a session, and the SessionFsProvider docs say to implement all ten core methods instead of only the ones a backing store needs.
    • The Node.js, Python, Go and Rust manual tool resume samples now set a permission handler and stop clients gracefully, so they complete instead of hanging at the permission prompt.
    • Sessions whose client tools returned contents, causalDependencies or remediation values outside the event schema can be resumed again, instead of failing with "Session file is corrupted".
    • Add LSP inventory, warmup, startup probes, enablement, and shutdown APIs.
    • GitHub service calls made while a session's first sign-in is still resolving no longer fail with "The bound session credential source changed".
    • .NET: a tool whose AIFunction returns a string, for example through AIFunctionFactoryOptions.MarshalResult or an AIFunction subclass, now sends that text to the model as-is instead of as a quoted JSON string.
    • Rust, Java, Python: concurrent installs of the bundled CLI no longer replace a copy another process is already running, which could make the first connection fail on Linux.
    • Java: a system message section transform callback that throws or returns null no longer hangs the session; the section keeps its original text, as it does when the callback's future fails.
    • Session setup no longer holds the registry lock while waiting for another operation on that session.
    • Live tool discovery no longer reports a closed session when an LSP client reset publishes its next generation.
    • Fix diagnostic memory sampling prolonging native runtime teardown.
    • Fixed permission requests waiting for host event acknowledgements after a response was already settled.
    • Local-model registry lookup honors nonempty COPILOT_HOME even if HOME and USERPROFILE are unset.
    • Go: a canvas action that returns a ToolResult without ResultType now sends its text and images to the model like a tool result, instead of the whole value as JSON text.
    • Add an optional permissionMode to session create and resume configs so a session starts in Manual, Assisted or Allow all mode before its first turn or resumed work; the applied result is available on the session.
    • Replaced the experimental kerberosAuth client option with an experimental network option whose resolveProxy and authenticateNegotiate callbacks let the SDK host decide the runtime's proxies, or leave a request to the runtime's own proxy resolution, and supply its Kerberos tokens.
    • Python: a tool, slash command, elicitation, skill provider or memory store handler that raises a BaseException that is not an Exception, such as pytest.fail(), now fails its request instead of leaving it unanswered.
    • Allocate exclusively owned temporary directories for macOS language-server startup probes.
    • Java: a storeMemory callback that throws a non-fatal Error, such as AssertionError, now fails the store_memory call promptly instead of leaving it unanswered until the 60-second timeout.
    • Fix .NET client shutdown racing in-flight JSON-RPC sends and preserve terminal error stack traces.
    • Java: a slash command or elicitation handler that throws an Error, such as an AssertionError, now fails or cancels its request instead of leaving it unanswered.
    • Python: Pending RPC requests now fail when the client is stopped instead of waiting indefinitely.
    • MCP deny rules now match the tool name the MCP server advertises as well as the sanitized name exposed to the model.
    • .NET: Fix native resource leaks when in-process client startup fails before connection setup completes.
    • Fixed cold session create and resume failing with "Custom agent not found" when the requested agent comes from a plugin enabled by enterprise managed settings.
    • Preserve SDK correlation IDs in telemetry emitted during native session creation and cold resume.
    • A turn that ends while the session event log cannot be written now still emits session.idle, so sendAndWait no longer times out on a completed turn.
    • Added Auto mode recovery for failed explicit-model requests in the Copilot SDK.
    • The SDK now rejects HTTPS runtime URLs.
    • Correct large-tool-output documentation to match the runtime's default threshold of 20480 bytes.
    • Retry failed local MCP connections when their effective sandbox launch policy changes.
    • In-workspace reads are approved without a judge call.
    • Assisted Autopilot no longer asks a human for permission.
    • Assisted Autopilot denials return feedback to the agent.
    • Required denied work ends with outcome blocked.
    • session.task_complete adds blockedActions.
    • Task blockers add reason permission_recovery_run_limit.
    • Hosts should render blocker and blockedActions.
    • Owning hosts can call internal session.ui.handleHuman*.
    • handleHuman* covers ask_user, user input, plan exit.
    • handleHuman* answers count as human input for the judge.
    • Generic handlePending* answers stay non-authoritative.
    • Permission requests carry assistedApprovalAssessment.
    • The assessment shows judge outcome, exclusion or failure.
    • permission.completed stays the authoritative result.
    • Add assistedApprovalContext to permissions.configure.
    • Judge host context is bounded, per-source and advisory.
    • Shell command analysis always runs for SDK sessions.
    • Read-only shell commands no longer ask for permission.
    • enableScriptSafety is deprecated and ignored.
    • Sandbox-bypass requests never offer session approval.
    • PermissionDecisionContext adds optional userFeedback.
    • userFeedback reaches only restricted telemetry.
    • PermissionAssistedApproval adds judge evaluationId.
    • extension-permission-access requests skip the judge.
    • Extension capability requests need explicit user consent.
    • Approval reasonCode adds extension-permission-access.
    • Assisted judge calls no longer count as premium requests.
    • On Linux, language servers are no longer told that the files in a directory were deleted when the directory is renamed away and straight back.
    • release note from following text with a blank line.`). Another tag, a heading, a list, a fence or a comment may still follow directly. Otherwise descriptions parse as before, one note per line. This came from the deep review's finding.
    • MCP tools/call requests now carry the runtime tool call ID in _meta["com.github.copilot/toolCallId"].
    • user.message events carry the clientTurnId of the send that delivered the message, when one was supplied.
    • send and sendAndWait accept an optional clientTurnId, which the runtime adds to MCP tools/call requests in that turn as _meta["com.github.copilot/turnId"].
    • Add session.model.startupAdmission to read startup model state and claim model enablement.
    • Attaching an empty PDF or Office file no longer fails the turn on models that read documents natively; it is passed as a file reference instead.
    • Rust: a tool handler that panics now fails its tool call with the error "tool handler panicked" instead of leaving the call unanswered until the turn is aborted.
    • Add allowMultipleToolCalls to session creation and resume to request single-call model responses while preserving existing parallel defaults.
    • Rust: the continue_pending_work docs now say to hand off a session with Client::stop, because Client::force_stop can lose pending work when it terminates a runtime the client started.
    • Fixed team customizations and feedback uploads ignoring SDK client and OS proxy settings.
    • Java: a user input, exit plan mode or auto mode switch handler that throws an Error (such as an AssertionError) is now answered with an error instead of leaving the turn waiting.
    • On Linux, language servers are now told when a directory is renamed while other directories in the workspace are being created and removed, such as during a package install.
    • Azure OpenAI BYOK providers again receive the default prompt-caching request shape; modelProvider only affects telemetry.
    • Go and Rust use owner-only per-user temporary caches on Unix when normal user-cache discovery is unavailable, preserving no-home fallback support.
    • Java generated RPC and event DTOs now provide named builders, avoiding source changes when optional schema properties are added.
    • Reload invalidated skill catalogs before preparing configured agent skill contexts.
    • Go, Node.js, Python, Java: a disconnected session is no longer kept by its client until stop(), so a long-lived client that creates and disconnects many sessions no longer grows in memory.
    • Python: a failed or cancelled CopilotClient.start() now stops the runtime process it spawned instead of leaving it running.
    • Preserve structured provider diagnostics in session error events and sendAndWait completion errors, including optional providerErrorCode.
    • .NET: hooks, the permission handler and session event handlers no longer run under the Activity that was current when the client started or the session was created, so spans and calls made from them are no longer attributed to that finished trace. Hooks now run under the trace context the runtime sends in the hook input.
    • Rust: the session event loop span is now a root span, so permission, tool, hook and other callback spans are no longer recorded under the span that was current when the session was created or resumed.
    • Prevent cancelled MCP authentication catch-up requests from cancelling a valid connection.
    • Add the ephemeral session.compaction_summarized event, emitted when a background compaction summary settles and before it is applied.
    • A session that starts indexed search in a new folder while another session of the same process is still stopping its index server now waits for that server and indexes the folder, instead of falling back to ripgrep for the rest of the session.
    • .NET: after a failed StartAsync, the next StartAsync or automatic start runs a new startup instead of rethrowing the first error.
    • Java: after a failed start(), the next start(), or the next automatic start when auto-start is enabled, runs a new startup instead of failing with the first error.
    • Permission prompt events for URL requests now include an optional parentDomainPattern, a wildcard covering the registrable domain and its subdomains, which hosts can offer as a session-scoped approval.
    • Java: generated union types and session events now serialize their discriminator once instead of twice, and an unknown session event keeps its original type when serialized.
    • Fix missing namespaces when replaying standalone deferred tool calls after switching from Claude to GPT, and provide continuation guidance for unrepaired namespace errors.
    • Rust: when the bundled runtime cannot be extracted, Client::start now reports the directory and the I/O error instead of saying the CLI is not bundled, and the next Client::start retries the extraction.
    • Adds SDK-owned session operations for feature flags, managed settings, dynamic context, permissions, model-context directories, sandbox state, working-directory context, and builtin-agent overrides.
    • Preserves explicit null experiment overrides in Java SDK requests.
    • Preserves stored automatic approval separately from effective policy approval in SDK responses.
    • Preserves explicit host permission requirements when temporary providers detach.
    • Adds explicit Go permission envelopes for lossless managed review while preserving existing public types and legacy callbacks.
    • session.model.switchTo now rejects an unsupported reasoningSummary, verbosity or contextTier with the same error as session creation, instead of recording it and leaving the session impossible to resume.
    • Fixed inconsistent plugin IDs between built-in plugin hooks, agents, skills, instructions, and plugins.list.
    • Added client-side programmatic tool calling support in the Copilot runtime SDK.
    • Rust preserves existing event payload construction and exposes experimental program provenance through an additive metadata wrapper.
    • Go programmatic events and permission callbacks expose optional ProgramToolCallID fields while retaining concrete payload/request types; positional struct literals require updating.
    • Fixed managed plugin reconciliation being skipped when a completed preparation plan still had unapplied defaults.
    • Python, Go: abandoning session.featureFlags.read by timeout or cancellation now sends $/cancelRequest, so the runtime stops waiting and no longer sends the snapshot to the dropped request later.
    • Fix continuing a resumed session hanging on an abandoned SDK tool callback when its handler is registered again.
    • session.options.update now rejects an unsupported reasoningSummary, verbosity or contextTier with the same error session.create gives, instead of storing it.
    • A repository whose remote uses GitHub's SSH-over-443 host ssh.github.com is now reported as its github.com repository in the session context and git.reposFromRemotes.
    • session.lsp.set now changes only disabledServers in the user's lsp-config.json, and no longer erases the definitions of other servers disabled with "disabled": true.
    • session.tasks.getProgress on a client-owned task now returns at most the 20 most recent progress messages in recentActivity, matching agent tasks.
    • session.lsp.diagnose no longer reports a working stdio language server as exiting immediately when the sandbox is off.
    • Python, Go: the skill provider docs now say that a running provider call is cancelled when the connection closes or the client is force-stopped, instead of saying that it runs until it returns.
    • Session shutdown now stops eager authentication requests once their last shared owner is released.
    • Session shutdown keeps credential bindings available while final session and process consumers drain.
    • MCP lifecycle requests now respect required sandbox admission while teardown remains available.
    • Installing a plugin from a GitHub or git repository that uses Git LFS downloads only the LFS files under the plugin's own path, so an unavailable LFS object elsewhere in the repository no longer fails the install.
    • Adds session preference updates through session.options.update.settings.
    • Python: fix intermittent Windows runtime installation failures when concurrent installers initialize the same cache lock file.
    • The task tool now dispatches to a custom agent added to .github/agents/ mid-session without requiring an agent reload.
    • Text after /init is now sent to the model as additional instructions instead of being dropped.
    • Disposed SDK sessions are now cleaned up.
    • The built-in web_fetch tool no longer strips markup from, or re-decodes, application/json and text/plain responses that quote an html tag near their start.
    • Unavailable models selected through environment variables or saved settings now fail when used instead of silently selecting another model.
    • Re-enabled and restarted local MCP servers use the session's current sandbox policy.
    • The built-in web_fetch tool rejects a negative start_index and a max_length below 1 with a validation error instead of reading them from the end of the page.
    • Sessions whose session.shutdown record holds a non-integer code-change line count, as some earlier CLI versions wrote, can be resumed again.
    • MCP list, listTools, OAuth login and OAuth state-change requests now respect required sandbox admission, and Apps diagnose no longer starts servers on a blocked session.
    • Local-model servers with persist: true are recorded and reused across runs when the runtime is launched without HOME or COPILOT_HOME.
    • listModels() before a session is created now recovers from 421 Misdirected Request after a plan change by re-resolving the account's endpoint once, instead of failing until a session is created.
    • Staff settings are written to the account's ~/.copilot/config.json instead of the working directory when the runtime is launched without HOME or COPILOT_HOME.
    • Go: Stop() and ForceStop() on a client connected with URIConnection no longer print "use of closed network connection" errors.
    • Invalid context values passed to session.metadata.recordContextChange and invalid type values passed to session.shutdown are now rejected with an error instead of making the session impossible to resume.
    • Fix a native crash when cancelling client-side JavaScript programs during compilation.
    • Resuming a stored session now reports a customAgents entry that a built-in agent shadows in session.custom_agents_updated, as create and resume of an open session already did.
    • .NET: Reduce JSON-RPC receive-buffer copying for coalesced messages.
    • A sessionStart or preToolUse file hook that returns "additionalContext": null no longer sends the text null to the model; null is treated as absent.
    • session.agent.list no longer fails with "Agent discovery inputs were superseded" when the agent catalog is invalidated concurrently.
    • Release consumed callback buffers in the .NET, Java, and Go in-process transports instead of retaining them while idle.
    • Model information now reports the resolved Copilot Fusion tier.
    • client.getAuthStatus() now includes login for a client signed in with the gitHubToken option, as it already did for GH_TOKEN.
    • After continuing from the session limit prompt, the session no longer records a stale "Session limit reached" notice.
    • Fixed the experimental network.resolveProxy callback not being asked for a session's remote MCP servers when it is registered with the default connection scope.
    • On Linux, a burst of file writes in a large workspace no longer costs seconds of CPU while a language server watches files.
    • Workflow resume now reports a limit that does not raise the approved one with a message naming the value it must exceed, instead of the out-of-range message.
    • Rust: Stop sending frames after a stream write failure while continuing to drain pending responses.
    • On Linux, language servers are now told about files created in a workspace directory that was deleted and recreated in one quick step, such as a build regenerating its output directories.
    • Fixed session rewind to report session-busy when a turn is running.
    • Fixed MCP OAuth for servers whose 401 names the protected-resource metadata with a relative resource_metadata path.
    • Session events: each assistant.message of a model response split at a reasoning boundary now carries chunkIndex and chunkCount, so clients can group the parts and find the last one.
    • Go: concurrent installs of the bundled CLI no longer replace a CLI another process already started when the install lock cannot be acquired.
    • A device Policy Helper's policy is applied again when a session without a GitHub sign-in is resumed, so repository hooks it locks no longer run.
    • The runtime now asks a session's gitHubTokenProvider for a refresh before each model call once the token has an hour or less left, not only at the start of a user message.
    • Update Node.js SDK Koffi and refresh compatible Rust SDK dependencies.
    • Fixed standalone host reporting rejected SDK tokens as missing tokens.
    • Fixed failures in MCP startup and session.send caused by slow configuration writes.
    • Fixed shared SDK commands becoming unavailable to the remaining client when the owner leaves.
    • Java: in-process clients that start at the same time on a cold runtime cache now extract the native runtime once instead of once per client.
    • .NET: SendAndWaitAsync no longer throws when the CLI exits right after completing a turn while an event handler is still running.
    • Fixed: session.agent.reload no longer fails with "Agent discovery inputs were superseded" when another change refreshes the agent catalog during the reload; it reloads again and returns the current catalog.
    • Fix plugin subagent dispatch after custom-agent catalog invalidation.
    • Rust: clients that start at the same time with the same bundled_cli_extract_dir now extract the bundled runtime once instead of once per client, and no longer install a second copy in a version subdirectory.
    • Fixed: indexed search now deletes cached per-repository indexes of repositories and worktrees that no longer exist, including indexes written before 1.0.108.
    • Fixed: with a custom session filesystem and the sandbox enabled, an attachment path that matched only a host-derived grant such as the runtime's temp directory is now denied, matching the file tools.
    • Sessionless agents, skills, hooks and instructions discovery now include plugins installed from a local directory marketplace.
    • Added built-in subagent allowlist configuration to create and resume sessions in all SDKs, including disabling built-ins while retaining custom agents.
    • The sandbox bypass decision event now reports prompt_unavailable, not user_prompted, when a host rejects the bypass prompt with an automated decisionContext.source such as host_policy.
    • Fixed mcp.oauth_required carrying grantType authorization_code for a client supplied to mcp.oauth.login; grantType is now present only for client_credentials, as the event schema declares.
    • Improved runtime reliability by recovering permission prompts after a host-acknowledgement timeout.
    • Resuming a session during a HydraFusion turn with the same GitHub token no longer makes the turn's remaining review and repair phases fail instantly.
    • Custom agents loaded from agent files or plugins without a tools list are now reported with the documented all-tools encoding (null tools in session.custom_agents_updated, no tools in AgentInfo) instead of the list ["*"].
    • Add connection-owned local model management through the SDK.
    • Skills and custom agents that an AHP host session gets from a plugin are now reported with source plugin, so the Python and Java SDKs can decode session.skills_loaded, skills.list and agent.list for those sessions.
    • Approving a plan written by HydraFusion, or switching models during a HydraFusion turn, now keeps the turn's first answer instead of failing its review and repair phases instantly.
    • session.mcp.listTools returns the declared McpTools shape again, with ui populated from a tool's MCP Apps metadata and without the raw tools/list fields.
    • The session.usage_info event's isInitial field is now true only for a session's first usage report, as documented, instead of for the first model request of every message.
    • External tool definitions accept an optional idempotent hint so the runtime can safely re-run a programmatic tool call whose outcome was lost; ProtocolExternalToolDefinition gains the field (source break for Go positional and exhaustive Rust literals).
    • session.tools.getCurrentMetadata entries now match CurrentToolMetadata: they no longer carry an undeclared title, and a tool registered without a description reports an empty description instead of omitting the required field.
    • session.permissions.modifyRules now rejects a scope other than "session" or "location" with an error, instead of reporting success without removing the requested rules.
    • Corrected the session.context_cleared event documentation, which named a Session.clearContextMessages method that no longer exists and omitted that the runtime also emits the event when it starts a fresh context window.
    • session.workspaces.truncateSummaries now rejects a missing, negative or non-integer keepCount instead of deleting every compaction checkpoint; an explicit 0 still deletes all of them.
    • Token providers: a lifetime rejection after token validation now reports the expiresIn the provider returned and what remained, without a GenericFailure, prefix, and the docs state that more than one hour must remain after the runtime validates the token.
    • Assisted Permissions grants (authenticatedAuthority) accept optional userMessages, the user's own messages from another session, which the judge reads as the user's messages; statements may be empty when they are present. A session started by another agent's message gets its task only from such a grant.
    • Reduce .NET SDK JSON-RPC allocations and session-history conversion overhead while preserving existing behavior.
    • Reduce Rust SDK allocations for large typed RPC responses by deserializing directly from response frames.
    • Support typed TelemetryConfig for independently owned in-process clients across all six SDKs.
    • Fix Rust-host extension consent and reconciliation, explicit cache flags, elicitation validation, and turn admission after disconnect.
    • Permission prompt requests can carry assistedApproval.approvalRequiredCommandSegments, the shell command segments an Assisted Permissions denial named as needing approval (experimental).
    • Fixed a bug where resumeSession could restore a BYOK model that had been withdrawn by the provider or deselected during sync.
    • availableTools and excludedTools now compose by default; SDK create/resume no longer sends toolFilterPrecedence, while explicit options.update precedence remains supported.
    • Fixed an issue where an invalid MCP server configuration caused every send to hang.
    • Resuming a saved session on the standalone runtime host now returns before its extensions start, so an extension's startup consent prompt reaches the client.
    • Prevent further descendant inference after factory cancellation while preserving child transcript cancellation boundaries without extra user-interruption reports.
    • Fixed session.compaction_complete for a compaction that blocks the turn sometimes arriving after that turn's session.idle.
    • An MCP server that throttles its first connection now reconnects automatically once the server lifts the block, instead of staying failed for the rest of the session.
    • session.permissions.resetSessionApprovals and session.permissions.configure({ urls }) now actually revoke URLs the user approved for the session; URLs from configuration or persisted settings are unaffected.
    • Added per-server reporting of MCP tool-definition token costs in the SDK.
    • Preserve prepared session tools when unchanged session-management settings are reapplied.
    • Sandbox allowedHosts and blockedHosts support strict IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs and resolved-address enforcement with deny precedence.
    • createSession now rejects reasoningEffort: "none" for models that don't support it instead of creating a session whose turns all fail.
    • Prevent duplicate cancellation notices when a new prompt follows an abort.
    • Sandboxed shells honor explicitly configured GH_TOKEN masking instead of replacing the token with automatic gh authentication.
    • Add an automation message source (automation- followed by an automation ID) for turns a host sends on behalf of a user-configured automation; such a turn defines the session's task without carrying human authority.
    • Limit incoming LLM HTTP responses and WebSocket messages to 128 MiB by default, configurable with COPILOT_LLM_RESPONSE_MAX_BYTES, including SDK callback ingress.
    • .NET: Incoming messages nested deeper than 64 levels, such as a tool call with deeply nested arguments, are no longer dropped, which had left the tool unrun and SendAndWaitAsync waiting.
    • Session history kept for enableSessionStore no longer loses a turn when two clients work on the same session one after the other.
    • Add experimental server-level offline trajectory analytics with ATIF input, request-local judge configuration, validation, classifier selection, bounded concurrency, exact retries, and structured rate-limit failures.
    • Go: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Runtime now lazily activates opted-in native extensions, reducing upfront activation work until those extensions are needed.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.31 Changelog Release notes →

    GitHub Copilot CLI

    All 158 changes

    Changes 158

    • Add IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow and deny rules in settings.
    • Add support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker under New models
    • copilot help input now says that Backspace at the start of shell input leaves shell mode and keeps the typed text, not only on an empty prompt
    • /subagents keeps its Overridden and Status columns readable on narrow terminals and aligns agent names with wide characters

    • Selecting a directory next to your home directory in /cd ~ or /add-dir ~ uses the correct full path

    • Make /terminal-setup configure Shift+Enter in the correct location for VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf on Linux when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set
    • The footer's AI credits now update as soon as /compact finishes instead of after the next turn
    • Prompt mode with --output-format json emits a final result record with an exit status even when a run fails early
    • Rate-limit errors now name the same mode as the switch dialog (Copilot Fusion mode or auto mode) instead of "auto model"
    • In a multi-line prompt, Up and Down now start from the cursor after Left, Right, Backspace, Delete or a similar key that had nothing to act on at the start or end of the text, instead of jumping to the column of the previous Up/Down run
    • Number keys keep working in shell and URL approval dialogs after pressing the number of the "No, and tell Copilot" option and moving back up
    • /cd . and /add-dir . now keep the current directory in a git repository instead of selecting .git; the directory picker lists ./ first and still offers hidden directories below it
    • In ACP mode, a preToolUse hook that answers ask now asks the ACP client to allow or deny the tool call instead of denying it as host policy
    • /voice immediately reports an overly long socket path and how to fix it, instead of waiting before showing a generic error.
    • File move permission prompts show both source and destination paths, and pure renames no longer show an empty diff.
    • Session history keeps every turn when a second window works on a session another window still has open
    • The beepOnSchedule setting description now says it controls the beep when a scheduled /every or /after turn finishes, and only while beep is on, instead of a beep when the prompt fires
    • The companyAnnouncements setting description now says one message, picked at random, appears in the timeline as a Company announcement notice, not in the startup banner
    • copilot help config no longer says turning off compactPaste shows every paste in full; pastes over 20 KB are still saved to a workspace file
    • copilot help config now names the home screen tabs as they appear, Current and Sessions, instead of Session and Agents
    • The ctrl+h entry in the keyboard shortcut help now says it deletes the previous word in local Windows terminals, where the terminal sends the same key for ctrl+h and ctrl+backspace
    • The footer.showModelEffort setting description now says it toggles only the reasoning effort label next to the model name, which always shows, and that the effort shows briefly after it changes when the setting is unset
    • copilot help config no longer names staff-only and internal settings, such as taskbarPresence, showTipsOnStartup and streamerMode
    • The ide.openDiffOnEdit setting description now says the IDE diff opens for a file edit waiting for your approval, and that accepting or rejecting it answers that prompt, instead of a diff on every edit
    • Text typed after /init now reaches the model as extra guidance for the generated instructions file and appears in the timeline, instead of being silently dropped.
    • The /init usage hint now shows [suppress|<instructions>], since text after /init guides what it writes, instead of listing only suppress
    • The inlineImages setting description no longer says images render with Sixel graphics by default; Sixel is used only with experimental features on
    • MCP tool results that return text as a base64 blob resource with a text MIME type, such as text/plain or application/json, now reach the model instead of arriving as an empty result
    • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment no longer say COPILOT_PROVIDER_BEARER_TOKEN always takes precedence over COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY: it does for openai and azure, but anthropic sends both
    • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment now say COPILOT_PROVIDER_MODEL_ID and COPILOT_PROVIDER_WIRE_MODEL default to the --model value before COPILOT_MODEL, and that the wire model falls back to COPILOT_PROVIDER_MODEL_ID
    • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment now say COPILOT_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT=websockets works only with provider type openai and the responses wire API, instead of implying it works for azure and anthropic too
    • copilot help providers-env no longer says COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY_COMMAND output is always sent: it says the command does not run when COPILOT_PROVIDER_BEARER_TOKEN is set, and that a custom credential header's precedence depends on the provider type
    • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment now say that COPILOT_PROVIDER_* variables take precedence over a saved providers.json, unless COPILOT_PROVIDERS_CONFIG names the file
    • copilot help providers-local now says Copilot looks for Ollama only on this machine, and that an OLLAMA_HOST on another machine is ignored
    • Running /research again on the same topic, or on a topic that starts with the same words, now saves a new report instead of trying to write over the earlier one.
    • The sandbox.auth.git setting description now says sandboxed git gets a masked credential that the sandbox proxy swaps for the real one only at that HTTPS origin, and that hosts other than GitHub use your own git credential helper, instead of saying the GitHub token is injected
    • The sandbox.userPolicy.network.proxy.url setting description now says sandboxed traffic always reaches the configured proxy through the built-in local proxy, which keeps proxy credentials away from sandboxed commands, instead of saying traffic without host rules uses the proxy directly
    • Sessions closed or disposed outside the sessions API no longer stay in memory in the CLI's embedded SDK server
    • A collapsed grep or glob row now counts only the files or lines a search found, not the summary lines of a large result or an appended warning, which made an empty search read "3 files found".
    • The search subagent's semantic_search tool now tells the model it returns up to 5 excerpts from GitHub's code index for the repository, instead of claiming to search the local workspace and return its full contents when small.
    • The /settings value column, the footer's model name and the startup warning for an invalid allowedUrls or deniedUrls entry no longer pass control characters from settings.json to the terminal.
    • The subagents.maxConcurrency and subagents.maxDepth setting descriptions now say the settings are ignored on Copilot plans without usage-based billing, instead of saying they apply only to usage-based billing users
    • copilot update --help no longer calls stable the default update channel: with no channel argument and no autoUpdatesChannel setting, a prerelease build stays on prerelease
    • A mistyped server in your own mcp-config.json is now reported at startup and in mcp list, and an mcp-config.json that cannot be used names the file and the real problem.
    • On Windows, memory the runtime frees after a turn, a session resume or a closed session is now returned to the system instead of staying committed to the process
    • copilot workflow run now explains that dynamic workflows need experimental features (or a non-disabled extension mode) and exits with status 2, instead of failing with an internal error
    • Cancelled, denied, or failed memory votes now show "Memory update failed" in the timeline
    • Unquoted prompts get accurate quoting guidance without suggestions that turn CLI options into prompt text.
    • Keep selected skill problems visible while navigating long /skills problem lists
    • Show parser errors for mistyped --prompt/--interactive options, and shell-neutral guidance instead of an unsafe -i suggestion for prompts with shell-sensitive characters
    • Repository settings warnings point to the actual syntax error in files with comments or trailing commas
    • Preserve file names, globs, and links in expanded JSON tool results instead of interpreting them as Markdown
    • Display search patterns and tool errors in the concise transcript without letting escape sequences alter terminal colors or formatting.
    • Preserve settings saved by other sessions when changing nested settings in /settings or /config

    • MCP dashboard now keeps runtime-only servers read-only on local sessions

    • Backspace at the start of shell input exits shell mode and keeps the typed text, so a prompt that enters shell mode while editing is no longer stuck there
    • Clear the compaction indicator when background summarization finishes, even while a tool is still running
    • Show an error when a selected or saved model is unavailable instead of silently switching to another model
    • Sandbox denied paths on Linux now block access to developer-tool configuration files inside those paths.
    • Use custom agents added to .github/agents/ during a session without reloading
    • Start sessions faster with --session-id when you have a large local session history
    • Preserve settings changes when another CLI session saves a different setting at the same time
    • Prevent duplicate shell commands from staying pending when parallel sub-agents request approval, including after resuming a session
    • IDE discovery and auto-connect work when the CLI cannot signal the IDE process, including across sandbox boundaries
    • Connect to MCP servers that omit optional discovery cache hints, making their tools available to Copilot
    • MCP servers can use stored secrets in the default profile without requiring --config-dir
    • Resume sessions saved by earlier CLI versions with unreadable code-change line counts
    • Ensure post-checkout hooks run Git commands against the intended repository when using --worktree
    • Ctrl+C dismisses dialogs or exits reverse search without cancelling an ongoing /compact
    • Resume sessions by name with --resume or /resume even when names contain special characters
    • Repository scans skip nested filesystems, avoiding stalled-mount exit delays on Linux when statx is available
    • Built-in file and text searches work on ARM64 Linux systems with 16 KiB or 64 KiB memory pages
    • Canceling the Autopilot confirmation leaves picker-submitted slash commands unexecuted, and confirming runs them only once
    • MCP servers disabled by repository settings now stop when you trust the folder, removing their tools from the session.

    • Preserve file contents when renaming files with case-only changes or moving them through symlinked directories

    • Stopping a background agent from /tasks also stops attached background shells started by it and its subagents, while leaving detached shells running

    • Keep repository-disabled skills disabled in /skills when trusting a folder for the current session only

    • CLI colors stay in sync when your terminal follows an OS light or dark theme change

    • Repaint the Windows terminal at the correct size after rapid window resizing

    • Completed sessions show Done instead of staying stuck on Working in the sidebar after switching sessions
    • MCP allow rules now approve a tool named the way its MCP server advertises it (for example --allow-tool 'server(weather.lookup)' or a tool name longer than 64 characters), matching how deny rules already work
    • Preserve long responses in session history and resumed sessions, even if a later continuation fails
    • Recover instruction scoping when malformed frontmatter wraps list values over lines or quotes scoping keys
    • A sessionStart or preToolUse hook that returns "additionalContext": null no longer sends the text null to the model; null is treated as absent, as it already was for userPromptSubmitted
    • The session.usage_info event now reports isInitial as true only for the session's first usage report, as documented, instead of for the first model request of every message.
    • Copying wrapped values from dialogs such as /session info preserves paths without inserting extra line breaks
    • HydraFusion review and repair phases no longer fail instantly when an SDK app resumes the session with the same token while the turn is running.
    • In-session /resume now explains why a cloud history session ID cannot be resumed
    • Progress messages on client-owned background tasks are now capped at the 20 most recent, so a long-running SDK task no longer makes session.tasks.getProgress grow without bound or each progress update slower.
    • Listing models before any session exists no longer keeps failing with 421 Misdirected Request after a plan change; the account's endpoint is re-resolved and the list is retried once.
    • Local models with persist: true reuse their running server across runs when the CLI is launched without HOME or COPILOT_HOME, instead of starting a new server every time
    • /mcp commands that take a server name (enable, disable, get, edit, remove, auth and add) now use the whole name typed after the subcommand, so a mistyped multi-word name reports that the server was not found instead of acting on a server named after its first word.
    • Collapsed grep and glob rows no longer count the lines of the warning about unreadable files as results when part of the searched tree cannot be read.
    • On Linux, language servers are now told about files created in a workspace directory that was deleted and recreated in one quick step, such as a build or code generator regenerating its output directories.
    • Pasted text drops terminal color codes and invisible control characters so the model receives the text shown in the prompt
    • The packaged CLI ignores its embedded Node.js flags, such as --no-warnings, when they are passed back to it as arguments, instead of failing with an unexpected argument error
    • On Linux, a build writing many files into a large workspace no longer keeps a CPU core busy for seconds while language servers are watching files.
    • Ctrl+G in a question from the agent opens your typed or "Other" answer in your editor again, instead of cancelling the question.
    • In /sandbox, a path or host rule that settings.json lists twice now shows as one row, so deleting it no longer leaves the deleted row on screen or makes the next delete remove a different entry.
    • /pr shows every reviewer when a team name contains | or Markdown characters, instead of cutting the Reviews row off at the first |.
    • /lsp test no longer reports working stdio language servers as exiting immediately: the startup check keeps the server's input open while it watches, as a real client does.
    • A repository whose remote uses GitHub's SSH-over-443 host (ssh.github.com) is now recognised as its github.com repository, so the session knows its repository instead of treating the folder as outside GitHub.
    • /keep-alive busy restores sleep prevention on the next turn or session switch if its helper exits while a background session is working.
    • Installing a plugin from a GitHub or git repository that uses Git LFS now downloads only the LFS files inside the plugin's own folder, so an LFS file elsewhere in the repository that the server cannot provide no longer makes the install fail.
    • Selecting a custom agent with /agent no longer fails with "Agent discovery inputs were superseded" when something else refreshes the agent list at the same moment
    • web_fetch returns a JSON or plain-text response as the server sent it when <html appears near its start, instead of stripping the markup or decoding it with an encoding that a quoted <meta> element names
    • Indexed search now deletes the per-repository indexes it left in the cache for repositories and worktrees that no longer exist, including those written before version 1.0.108, which could grow to tens of gigabytes
    • web_fetch rejects a negative start_index and a max_length below 1 with a validation error, instead of reading them from the end of the page past the 20000-character cap or naming continuations that skip the last page
    • Pressing Ctrl+C right after pasting now clears the pasted text along with the rest of the prompt, instead of the paste showing up in the cleared prompt a moment later.
    • Turning a language server on or off no longer erases the settings of other servers disabled by hand with "disabled": true in lsp-config.json, so re-enabling one later no longer breaks every user language server.
    • A device Policy Helper's policy is applied again when a session without a GitHub sign-in is resumed, so settings it locks, such as repository hooks, stay locked
    • Staff settings are saved to your own ~/.copilot/config.json when the CLI starts without HOME or COPILOT_HOME, instead of a .copilot folder in the working directory
    • When a model provider rejects a request with a generic error such as "invalid request body" or "Bad Request" and one attached image is corrupt, the corrupt image is now omitted and the turn retried with the readable images instead of failing.
    • A prompt queued while the agent is working keeps its place in the queue when a model switch or queued command follows it quickly, so it runs on the model that was selected when it was submitted
    • Subagent rows in the timeline draw the agent type and model as plain text on one line, so escape sequences or line breaks in them no longer restyle the row, turn part of it into a hidden link or split it.
    • Changing directory with /cd from one indexed folder to another no longer leaves indexed search disabled for the rest of the session while the previous folder's index server is still stopping.
    • Adding an OAuth MCP server with /mcp add no longer says "Server Saved" before anything is saved, and if saving the config fails after you sign in, the form now shows why instead of reporting success and losing the server.
    • Changing the screen reader setting in /settings or /config now restarts the CLI or asks for a restart, and starting with --screen-reader offers to remember screen reader mode
    • Sessions no longer fail to start when the environment holds a variable whose name or value is not valid UTF-8; such variables are skipped instead of crashing the CLI.
    • Image and file labels remain whole when navigating or deleting them after an unfinished attachment label in the prompt
    • copilot instruction list run from a repository subdirectory lists each plugin rule once instead of twice
    • Interrupted --worktree checkouts stay intact, with manual recovery guidance that reminds you to preserve local changes and confirm Git has stopped.
    • Indexed search no longer stops for the rest of a session after one transient shared-index error, such as another process briefly holding the shared index cache
    • Resuming a session now restores its selected custom agent in /resume and prompt mode.
    • Resuming a session with no name from the Sessions sidebar no longer appears to rename it to "Session 1"
    • Keep your latest mode choice when switching sessions, instead of reverting to Plan mode
    • Completed subagent rows in the timeline show the model name instead of a hashed model identifier.
    • After /research, follow-up requests use normal session tool permissions.
    • Sandbox path settings support environment variables while preserving authored expressions in settings and the editor.
    • Use cache-aware background wait timeouts by default in interactive sessions
    • Ask for confirmation before /share or /export follows symlinks when saving local files
    • URL permission prompts let you approve every subdomain for the current session
    • Read-only shell scripts ask for permission less often, while scripts that change git refs or read files through hidden paths now always get reviewed

  14. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.31-preview.1

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    10 Nov 2026
    Changes
    128

    Preview release that stops the runtime process spawned by a failed or cancelled Python CopilotClient.start(). Preserves structured provider diagnostics in session errors and adds the ephemeral session.compaction summarized event.

    Key changes

    • Python: a failed or cancelled CopilotClient.start() now stops the runtime process it spawned instead of leaving it running.
    • Preserve structured provider diagnostics in session error events and sendAndWait completion errors, including optional providerErrorCode.
    • .NET: hooks, the permission handler and session event handlers no longer run under the Activity that was current when the client started or the session was created, so spans and calls made from them are no longer attributed to that finished trace. Hooks now run under the trace context the runtime sends in the hook input.
    • Rust: the session event loop span is now a root span, so permission, tool, hook and other callback spans are no longer recorded under the span that was current when the session was created or resumed.
    $ gh release view v1.0.31-preview.1 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 128 changes

    Changes 128

    • Python: a failed or cancelled CopilotClient.start() now stops the runtime process it spawned instead of leaving it running.
    • Preserve structured provider diagnostics in session error events and sendAndWait completion errors, including optional providerErrorCode.
    • .NET: hooks, the permission handler and session event handlers no longer run under the Activity that was current when the client started or the session was created, so spans and calls made from them are no longer attributed to that finished trace. Hooks now run under the trace context the runtime sends in the hook input.
    • Rust: the session event loop span is now a root span, so permission, tool, hook and other callback spans are no longer recorded under the span that was current when the session was created or resumed.
    • Prevent cancelled MCP authentication catch-up requests from cancelling a valid connection.
    • Add the ephemeral session.compaction_summarized event, emitted when a background compaction summary settles and before it is applied.
    • A session that starts indexed search in a new folder while another session of the same process is still stopping its index server now waits for that server and indexes the folder, instead of falling back to ripgrep for the rest of the session.
    • .NET: after a failed StartAsync, the next StartAsync or automatic start runs a new startup instead of rethrowing the first error.
    • Java: after a failed start(), the next start(), or the next automatic start when auto-start is enabled, runs a new startup instead of failing with the first error.
    • Permission prompt events for URL requests now include an optional parentDomainPattern, a wildcard covering the registrable domain and its subdomains, which hosts can offer as a session-scoped approval.
    • Java: generated union types and session events now serialize their discriminator once instead of twice, and an unknown session event keeps its original type when serialized.
    • Fix missing namespaces when replaying standalone deferred tool calls after switching from Claude to GPT, and provide continuation guidance for unrepaired namespace errors.
    • Rust: when the bundled runtime cannot be extracted, Client::start now reports the directory and the I/O error instead of saying the CLI is not bundled, and the next Client::start retries the extraction.
    • Adds SDK-owned session operations for feature flags, managed settings, dynamic context, permissions, model-context directories, sandbox state, working-directory context, and builtin-agent overrides.
    • Preserves explicit null experiment overrides in Java SDK requests.
    • Preserves stored automatic approval separately from effective policy approval in SDK responses.
    • Preserves explicit host permission requirements when temporary providers detach.
    • Adds explicit Go permission envelopes for lossless managed review while preserving existing public types and legacy callbacks.
    • session.model.switchTo now rejects an unsupported reasoningSummary, verbosity or contextTier with the same error as session creation, instead of recording it and leaving the session impossible to resume.
    • Fixed inconsistent plugin IDs between built-in plugin hooks, agents, skills, instructions, and plugins.list.
    • Added client-side programmatic tool calling support in the Copilot runtime SDK.
    • Rust preserves existing event payload construction and exposes experimental program provenance through an additive metadata wrapper.
    • Go programmatic events and permission callbacks expose optional ProgramToolCallID fields while retaining concrete payload/request types; positional struct literals require updating.
    • Fixed managed plugin reconciliation being skipped when a completed preparation plan still had unapplied defaults.
    • Python, Go: abandoning session.featureFlags.read by timeout or cancellation now sends $/cancelRequest, so the runtime stops waiting and no longer sends the snapshot to the dropped request later.
    • Fix continuing a resumed session hanging on an abandoned SDK tool callback when its handler is registered again.
    • session.options.update now rejects an unsupported reasoningSummary, verbosity or contextTier with the same error session.create gives, instead of storing it.
    • A repository whose remote uses GitHub's SSH-over-443 host ssh.github.com is now reported as its github.com repository in the session context and git.reposFromRemotes.
    • session.lsp.set now changes only disabledServers in the user's lsp-config.json, and no longer erases the definitions of other servers disabled with "disabled": true.
    • session.tasks.getProgress on a client-owned task now returns at most the 20 most recent progress messages in recentActivity, matching agent tasks.
    • session.lsp.diagnose no longer reports a working stdio language server as exiting immediately when the sandbox is off.
    • Python, Go: the skill provider docs now say that a running provider call is cancelled when the connection closes or the client is force-stopped, instead of saying that it runs until it returns.
    • Session shutdown now stops eager authentication requests once their last shared owner is released.
    • Session shutdown keeps credential bindings available while final session and process consumers drain.
    • MCP lifecycle requests now respect required sandbox admission while teardown remains available.
    • Installing a plugin from a GitHub or git repository that uses Git LFS downloads only the LFS files under the plugin's own path, so an unavailable LFS object elsewhere in the repository no longer fails the install.
    • Adds session preference updates through session.options.update.settings.
    • Python: fix intermittent Windows runtime installation failures when concurrent installers initialize the same cache lock file.
    • The task tool now dispatches to a custom agent added to .github/agents/ mid-session without requiring an agent reload.
    • Text after /init is now sent to the model as additional instructions instead of being dropped.
    • Disposed SDK sessions are now cleaned up.
    • The built-in web_fetch tool no longer strips markup from, or re-decodes, application/json and text/plain responses that quote an html tag near their start.
    • Unavailable models selected through environment variables or saved settings now fail when used instead of silently selecting another model.
    • Re-enabled and restarted local MCP servers use the session's current sandbox policy.
    • The built-in web_fetch tool rejects a negative start_index and a max_length below 1 with a validation error instead of reading them from the end of the page.
    • Sessions whose session.shutdown record holds a non-integer code-change line count, as some earlier CLI versions wrote, can be resumed again.
    • MCP list, listTools, OAuth login and OAuth state-change requests now respect required sandbox admission, and Apps diagnose no longer starts servers on a blocked session.
    • Local-model servers with persist: true are recorded and reused across runs when the runtime is launched without HOME or COPILOT_HOME.
    • listModels() before a session is created now recovers from 421 Misdirected Request after a plan change by re-resolving the account's endpoint once, instead of failing until a session is created.
    • Staff settings are written to the account's ~/.copilot/config.json instead of the working directory when the runtime is launched without HOME or COPILOT_HOME.
    • Go: Stop() and ForceStop() on a client connected with URIConnection no longer print "use of closed network connection" errors.
    • Invalid context values passed to session.metadata.recordContextChange and invalid type values passed to session.shutdown are now rejected with an error instead of making the session impossible to resume.
    • Fix a native crash when cancelling client-side JavaScript programs during compilation.
    • Resuming a stored session now reports a customAgents entry that a built-in agent shadows in session.custom_agents_updated, as create and resume of an open session already did.
    • .NET: Reduce JSON-RPC receive-buffer copying for coalesced messages.
    • A sessionStart or preToolUse file hook that returns "additionalContext": null no longer sends the text null to the model; null is treated as absent.
    • session.agent.list no longer fails with "Agent discovery inputs were superseded" when the agent catalog is invalidated concurrently.
    • Release consumed callback buffers in the .NET, Java, and Go in-process transports instead of retaining them while idle.
    • Model information now reports the resolved Copilot Fusion tier.
    • client.getAuthStatus() now includes login for a client signed in with the gitHubToken option, as it already did for GH_TOKEN.
    • After continuing from the session limit prompt, the session no longer records a stale "Session limit reached" notice.
    • Fixed the experimental network.resolveProxy callback not being asked for a session's remote MCP servers when it is registered with the default connection scope.
    • On Linux, a burst of file writes in a large workspace no longer costs seconds of CPU while a language server watches files.
    • Workflow resume now reports a limit that does not raise the approved one with a message naming the value it must exceed, instead of the out-of-range message.
    • Rust: Stop sending frames after a stream write failure while continuing to drain pending responses.
    • On Linux, language servers are now told about files created in a workspace directory that was deleted and recreated in one quick step, such as a build regenerating its output directories.
    • Fixed session rewind to report session-busy when a turn is running.
    • Fixed MCP OAuth for servers whose 401 names the protected-resource metadata with a relative resource_metadata path.
    • Session events: each assistant.message of a model response split at a reasoning boundary now carries chunkIndex and chunkCount, so clients can group the parts and find the last one.
    • Go: concurrent installs of the bundled CLI no longer replace a CLI another process already started when the install lock cannot be acquired.
    • A device Policy Helper's policy is applied again when a session without a GitHub sign-in is resumed, so repository hooks it locks no longer run.
    • The runtime now asks a session's gitHubTokenProvider for a refresh before each model call once the token has an hour or less left, not only at the start of a user message.
    • Update Node.js SDK Koffi and refresh compatible Rust SDK dependencies.
    • Fixed standalone host reporting rejected SDK tokens as missing tokens.
    • Fixed failures in MCP startup and session.send caused by slow configuration writes.
    • Fixed shared SDK commands becoming unavailable to the remaining client when the owner leaves.
    • Java: in-process clients that start at the same time on a cold runtime cache now extract the native runtime once instead of once per client.
    • .NET: SendAndWaitAsync no longer throws when the CLI exits right after completing a turn while an event handler is still running.
    • Fixed: session.agent.reload no longer fails with "Agent discovery inputs were superseded" when another change refreshes the agent catalog during the reload; it reloads again and returns the current catalog.
    • Fix plugin subagent dispatch after custom-agent catalog invalidation.
    • Rust: clients that start at the same time with the same bundled_cli_extract_dir now extract the bundled runtime once instead of once per client, and no longer install a second copy in a version subdirectory.
    • Fixed: indexed search now deletes cached per-repository indexes of repositories and worktrees that no longer exist, including indexes written before 1.0.108.
    • Fixed: with a custom session filesystem and the sandbox enabled, an attachment path that matched only a host-derived grant such as the runtime's temp directory is now denied, matching the file tools.
    • Sessionless agents, skills, hooks and instructions discovery now include plugins installed from a local directory marketplace.
    • Added built-in subagent allowlist configuration to create and resume sessions in all SDKs, including disabling built-ins while retaining custom agents.
    • The sandbox bypass decision event now reports prompt_unavailable, not user_prompted, when a host rejects the bypass prompt with an automated decisionContext.source such as host_policy.
    • Fixed mcp.oauth_required carrying grantType authorization_code for a client supplied to mcp.oauth.login; grantType is now present only for client_credentials, as the event schema declares.
    • Improved runtime reliability by recovering permission prompts after a host-acknowledgement timeout.
    • Resuming a session during a HydraFusion turn with the same GitHub token no longer makes the turn's remaining review and repair phases fail instantly.
    • Custom agents loaded from agent files or plugins without a tools list are now reported with the documented all-tools encoding (null tools in session.custom_agents_updated, no tools in AgentInfo) instead of the list ["*"].
    • Add connection-owned local model management through the SDK.
    • Skills and custom agents that an AHP host session gets from a plugin are now reported with source plugin, so the Python and Java SDKs can decode session.skills_loaded, skills.list and agent.list for those sessions.
    • Approving a plan written by HydraFusion, or switching models during a HydraFusion turn, now keeps the turn's first answer instead of failing its review and repair phases instantly.
    • session.mcp.listTools returns the declared McpTools shape again, with ui populated from a tool's MCP Apps metadata and without the raw tools/list fields.
    • The session.usage_info event's isInitial field is now true only for a session's first usage report, as documented, instead of for the first model request of every message.
    • External tool definitions accept an optional idempotent hint so the runtime can safely re-run a programmatic tool call whose outcome was lost; ProtocolExternalToolDefinition gains the field (source break for Go positional and exhaustive Rust literals).
    • session.tools.getCurrentMetadata entries now match CurrentToolMetadata: they no longer carry an undeclared title, and a tool registered without a description reports an empty description instead of omitting the required field.
    • session.permissions.modifyRules now rejects a scope other than "session" or "location" with an error, instead of reporting success without removing the requested rules.
    • Corrected the session.context_cleared event documentation, which named a Session.clearContextMessages method that no longer exists and omitted that the runtime also emits the event when it starts a fresh context window.
    • session.workspaces.truncateSummaries now rejects a missing, negative or non-integer keepCount instead of deleting every compaction checkpoint; an explicit 0 still deletes all of them.
    • Token providers: a lifetime rejection after token validation now reports the expiresIn the provider returned and what remained, without a GenericFailure, prefix, and the docs state that more than one hour must remain after the runtime validates the token.
    • Assisted Permissions grants (authenticatedAuthority) accept optional userMessages, the user's own messages from another session, which the judge reads as the user's messages; statements may be empty when they are present. A session started by another agent's message gets its task only from such a grant.
    • Reduce .NET SDK JSON-RPC allocations and session-history conversion overhead while preserving existing behavior.
    • Reduce Rust SDK allocations for large typed RPC responses by deserializing directly from response frames.
    • Support typed TelemetryConfig for independently owned in-process clients across all six SDKs.
    • Fix Rust-host extension consent and reconciliation, explicit cache flags, elicitation validation, and turn admission after disconnect.
    • Permission prompt requests can carry assistedApproval.approvalRequiredCommandSegments, the shell command segments an Assisted Permissions denial named as needing approval (experimental).
    • Fixed a bug where resumeSession could restore a BYOK model that had been withdrawn by the provider or deselected during sync.
    • availableTools and excludedTools now compose by default; SDK create/resume no longer sends toolFilterPrecedence, while explicit options.update precedence remains supported.
    • Fixed an issue where an invalid MCP server configuration caused every send to hang.
    • Resuming a saved session on the standalone runtime host now returns before its extensions start, so an extension's startup consent prompt reaches the client.
    • Prevent further descendant inference after factory cancellation while preserving child transcript cancellation boundaries without extra user-interruption reports.
    • Fixed session.compaction_complete for a compaction that blocks the turn sometimes arriving after that turn's session.idle.
    • An MCP server that throttles its first connection now reconnects automatically once the server lifts the block, instead of staying failed for the rest of the session.
    • session.permissions.resetSessionApprovals and session.permissions.configure({ urls }) now actually revoke URLs the user approved for the session; URLs from configuration or persisted settings are unaffected.
    • Added per-server reporting of MCP tool-definition token costs in the SDK.
    • Preserve prepared session tools when unchanged session-management settings are reapplied.
    • Sandbox allowedHosts and blockedHosts support strict IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs and resolved-address enforcement with deny precedence.
    • createSession now rejects reasoningEffort: "none" for models that don't support it instead of creating a session whose turns all fail.
    • Prevent duplicate cancellation notices when a new prompt follows an abort.
    • Sandboxed shells honor explicitly configured GH_TOKEN masking instead of replacing the token with automatic gh authentication.
    • Add an automation message source (automation- followed by an automation ID) for turns a host sends on behalf of a user-configured automation; such a turn defines the session's task without carrying human authority.
    • Limit incoming LLM HTTP responses and WebSocket messages to 128 MiB by default, configurable with COPILOT_LLM_RESPONSE_MAX_BYTES, including SDK callback ingress.
    • .NET: Incoming messages nested deeper than 64 levels, such as a tool call with deeply nested arguments, are no longer dropped, which had left the tool unrun and SendAndWaitAsync waiting.
    • Session history kept for enableSessionStore no longer loses a turn when two clients work on the same session one after the other.
    • Add experimental server-level offline trajectory analytics with ATIF input, request-local judge configuration, validation, classifier selection, bounded concurrency, exact retries, and structured rate-limit failures.
    • Go: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Runtime now lazily activates opted-in native extensions, reducing upfront activation work until those extensions are needed.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.31-preview.1 Changelog Release notes →

    Pre-release that adds IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host rules and Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker. Sandbox path settings now support environment variables, and background wait timeouts are cache-aware by default.

    Key changes

    • Add IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow and deny rules in settings.

    $ gh release view v1.0.109-1 --repo github/copilot-cli
    All 22 changes

    Added 2

    • Add IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow and deny rules in settings.
    • Add support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker under New models

    Improved 2

    • Sandbox path settings support environment variables while preserving authored expressions in settings and the editor.
    • Use cache-aware background wait timeouts by default in interactive sessions

    Fixed 18

    • copilot help input now says that Backspace at the start of shell input leaves shell mode and keeps the typed text, not only on an empty prompt
    • /subagents keeps its Overridden and Status columns readable on narrow terminals and aligns agent names with wide characters
    • Removing a built-in MCP server with copilot mcp remove or /mcp delete explains how to disable it instead
    • Selecting a directory next to your home directory in /cd ~ or /add-dir ~ uses the correct full path
    • Trusted-folder and worktree confirmations keep Windows path separators
    • Hide empty assistant reply bullets when a response contains only whitespace
    • Choosing "don't ask again" for parallel file operations approves all covered requests without prompting again
    • Make /terminal-setup configure Shift+Enter in the correct location for VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf on Linux when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set
    • The footer's AI credits now update as soon as /compact finishes instead of after the next turn
    • Prompt mode with --output-format json emits a final result record with an exit status even when a run fails early
    • Rate-limit errors now name the same mode as the switch dialog (Copilot Fusion mode or auto mode) instead of "auto model"
    • In a multi-line prompt, Up and Down now start from the cursor after Left, Right, Backspace, Delete or a similar key that had nothing to act on at the start or end of the text, instead of jumping to the column of the previous Up/Down run
    • Number keys keep working in shell and URL approval dialogs after pressing the number of the "No, and tell Copilot" option and moving back up
    • /cd . and /add-dir . now keep the current directory in a git repository instead of selecting .git; the directory picker lists ./ first and still offers hidden directories below it
    • In ACP mode, a preToolUse hook that answers ask now asks the ACP client to allow or deny the tool call instead of denying it as host policy
    • /voice immediately reports an overly long socket path and how to fix it, instead of waiting before showing a generic error.
    • File move permission prompts show both source and destination paths, and pure renames no longer show an empty diff.
    • Session history keeps every turn when a second window works on a session another window still has open
